messages:
ada: Quick heads-up — PR #4926 landed a bunch of snippet changes for function/tool calling + structured output. Need someone to run guardrail sanity checks and own followup link fixes.

morgan: I can take snippet ownership for docs + update the Python/JS examples to match the SDK changes. Will start a pass tonight. @ada any specific failing examples you saw?

ada: Thanks @morgan. The main problems were: 1) a couple of JSON examples use `null` vs empty object inconsistently, 2) our parse-fallback example isn't runnable (missing shim), 3) a dead anchor link in the tool-calling section.

samir: Re: parse-fallback — we should show an explicit schema with a `oneOf` that allows the canonical response or a fallback envelope. Quick example I pasted in the PR comments but worth adding to the guide:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string"},
    "payload": {"type": ["object", "null"]}
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```

samir: Also suggest adding a tiny parse shim snippet so users can call our SDK parse helper and fall back to naive JSON.parse when validation fails.

lex: Heads-up: current JS SDK example in the PR uses `await client.call({ tool: ... })` but Python uses `client.invoke(...)`. We should standardize naming in the docs or show both patterns side-by-side. Otherwise readers will be confused.

morgan: Good catch, @lex. I'll align the wording to "call/invoke (SDK name varies)" and include both short snippets.

chris.docs: If someone can produce the updated runnable examples, I can run the docs smoke tests and fix anchor links. Also please include a short note about when to use `null` vs `{}` for optional payloads — that was tripping users in support.

emily: I'll add a small test in the docs CI that loads every example JSON in `docs/examples/tool-calling` and runs `redwood-parse --check` (a hypothetical script) so we catch these earlier. Owning that test.

ada: Nice. @emily can you add the test as a separate commit so it's reviewable? Also @morgan please include a short changelog of snippet edits in the PR description so we can audit examples vs SDK docs.

morgan: Yep. Plan: 1) normalize payload examples to allow `null`, 2) add parse shim snippet (Python + JS), 3) align call/invoke naming, 4) fix dead anchor, 5) update PR desc. Will ping when ready for review.

deploy-bot: CI status: docs-build #3472 — lint OK, linkcheck pending, examples-run queued.

samir: One more thought — add a tiny section called "Fallback envelope example" that shows how to wrap non-conforming tool outputs into `{ "fallback": true, "raw": "..." }` so integrators know one pattern. Keep it short.

chris.docs: Love that. Let's keep the new section <100 words and one minimal code example. If @morgan can target that, I'll merge after smoke tests pass.

morgan: I'll aim to update the PR by EOD and add tests. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ada: Awesome. Marking this thread as follow-up for docs triage. If anyone catches more edge cases while editing, drop them here and we'll batch into the same PR.
